title: Pavel Aprelev - Projects
intro: Side projects I build in my spare time, mostly with Claude Code: simulations, games, agent tooling and small apps for my family.

projects.name: Petrium
projects.summary: A cellular-evolution simulator turning into a puzzle game. Design cells by editing their DNA, then guide colonies through resource, toxin and rival pressure. Runs entirely in the browser.

projects.name: Kids' tablet games
projects.summary: Ad-free, tracking-free games built for cheap tablets: a coloring and dress-up app, plus small arcade games (a rhythm platformer, slime sports and a turn-based tank game).

projects.name: Labyrinthium
projects.summary: A web version of the pen-and-paper game Labyrinth: the computer holds a hidden multi-level maze, players explore blind and draw their own maps. Includes a Bayesian bot opponent.

projects.name: Philly commuter bot
projects.summary: A morning commute briefing for the Philadelphia area: SEPTA alerts and trains, traffic, weather and routes, delivered over Telegram and as a tool AI assistants can call.

projects.name: Agent team manager
projects.summary: A dashboard for running teams of AI coding agents (supervisors, builders and challengers) against a project, each in its own workspace, with per-project team configurations.

projects.name: Family apps
projects.summary: Private apps for my family: a multilingual family-history tree built from letters, interviews and photos, a trip planner with offline itineraries and allergy-safe dining, and a fitness coaching backend.
